content.text:
**Notice to Employees of Hartwell Germany: Skills Suggestion Tool**

**What it is**
Hartwell is using a tool called PK-1 to suggest skills for your profile. It looks at your own work records and proposes skills you may have. You decide what happens: each suggestion is shown to you, and you can accept or reject it. Nothing is added to your profile unless you accept it.

**Who it affects**
About 9,000 salaried staff across Hartwell's sites, including Germany.

**What it reads**
Only project reports, ticket notes, learning records, and your project roles.

**What it never reads**
Working hours, activity data, email, chat, badge and location data, or performance ratings.

**Who sees the output**
In Germany, the suggestions are used only by the talent.search, mobility.match and learning.recommend functions. No other system or reader receives them.

**How we tested it for fairness**
In February 2028 we reviewed 4,000 suggestions by site, age band and sex. No group's acceptance rate fell below 0.8 of the highest group's rate.

**What is logged and kept**
- Rejected suggestions are kept for 90 days, then only anonymous counts are kept.
- Group-level counts are kept for 84 months.
- The access log is reviewed monthly by the Betriebsrat (works council).

**How to get help or raise a concern**
Contact the HR service desk first. You can also go to the works council or the employee panel.

**How to switch it off**
Go to your profile settings and use the single switch to turn the tool off. Entries you have already accepted stay on your profile unless you delete them yourself.

content.text:
**Notice to employees of Hartwell Germany: Skill Suggestions**

**What this system does**
The skills tool suggests skills for your profile, based on your own work records. You decide what happens to each suggestion. Nothing is added to your profile until you accept it. You can reject any suggestion.

**What it reads**
It reads project reports, ticket notes, learning records and your project roles. It does not read your working hours, activity data, email, chat, badge or location data, or performance ratings.

**Who sees the results**
In Germany, the suggestions are used only by the talent search, mobility matching and learning recommendation tools. No other reader has access in Germany.

**Fairness checks**
In February 2028 we tested 4,000 suggestions, grouped by site, age band and sex. Acceptance rates for every group were at least 0.8 of the highest group's rate.

**What is logged and kept**
Rejected suggestions are kept for 90 days, then only anonymous counts are kept. Group counts are kept for 84 months. The works council (Betriebsrat) reads the access log every month.

**Questions or concerns**
Contact the HR service desk first. If you are not satisfied, you can take the matter to the works council or the employee panel.

**Switching it off**
You can turn the skill suggestions off with one switch in your profile settings. Entries you have already accepted stay on your profile unless you delete them.

content.text:
**Notice to employees of Hartwell Germany: Skill Suggestions**

**What this is**
Hartwell is using a tool called PK-1. It looks at your own work records and suggests skills you may want on your profile. You decide what happens to each suggestion: you can accept it or reject it. Nothing is added to your profile until you accept it.

**What it reads**
- Project reports
- Ticket notes
- Learning records
- Your project roles

**What it never reads**
- Working hours or time records
- Activity data
- Email or chat
- Badge or location data
- Performance ratings

**Who sees the results**
In Germany, the suggestions are used only by the talent.search, mobility.match and learning.recommend tools. No other system or reader receives them. The tool is not used for performance assessment in any location.

**Your right to say no**
Profile settings have a single switch that turns the feature off. Skills you have already accepted stay on your profile unless you delete them.

**Logs and retention**
- Rejected suggestions are kept for 90 days, then only anonymous counts are kept.
- Group-level counts are kept for 84 months.
- The works council (Betriebsrat) reads the access log every month.

**How it was tested**
In February 2028, we checked 4,000 suggestions by site, age band and sex. No group's acceptance rate fell below 0.8 of the highest group's rate.

**Questions or concerns**
Contact the HR service desk first. If you are not satisfied, you can raise it with the works council or the employee panel.
